For Pat’s 10-mile endurance run, the ideal music selection should feature a steady, driving beat between 160-180 BPM to help maintain her pace, with minimal lyrical distractions to support her meditative state. Recommended genres include progressive house, deep techno, or ambient electronic. Specific tracks could include "Opus" by Eric Prydz, "Innerbloom" by RÜFÜS DU SOL, or "Strobe" by Deadmau5, all of which offer consistent rhythms and immersive soundscapes suitable for long-distance running.
